name: kimi
description: Kimi (Moonshot AI) runner via Kimi Code CLI or Moonshot API

backend.description: Backend: cli (Kimi Code CLI, carries MCP tools and session continuity) or api (Moonshot Chat Completions)

model.description: Default model (selection via models registry, not restricted by enum)

base_url.description: Moonshot serves api.moonshot.ai and api.moonshot.cn to different audiences

timeout.description: Ceiling on a single turn, in seconds

max_retries.description: Retries after the first attempt (2 = three attempts total)

allowed_tools.description: CLI-internal tools to enable. Empty means none are enabled — not 'no restriction'. MCP tools are fenced by the gateway ACL instead

use_pool.description: Keep CLI processes alive between turns

pool_max_age.description: Maximum lifetime of a pooled process, enforced at handoff and at the reaper tick

cli_meta.token_hint: Get your API key from Moonshot Console
